native_canopy_source.name: canopy
native_canopy_source.prompt_en: <Picture 1> displays the Huangshan welcoming pine canopy in a locked-tripod detail for 8.2083 seconds. The granite peaks, trunk, large branches, and entire canopy geometry remain in exactly the reference coordinates and scale. Only tiny needle clusters and the very outermost twigs sway gently by a few pixels in a light mountain breeze, creating smooth slow continuous natural wind with no sudden gust, no branch contraction or expanding canopy. Very light distant atmospheric vapor moves slowly around fixed rocks. The top and bottom framing stay identical, with no camera move, cut, dissolve, zoom, rotation, new branches, bird, or animal. The tree is living, with a rigid main structure and small soft leaf motion. No object is added. There is no speech, music, or text. The crop will be layered over the upper background of the original locked shot; its lower edge must stay at exactly the same scene coordinates. Describe restrained motion throughout, not a frozen hold.

dialogue.text: 姐姐，这只猴子坐得好高呀！它在看什么？
我们去黄山，找找答案。
咦？它好像在跟我打招呼！
你好呀！我是小苏打！
这是迎客松。你看，它伸出的枝条，像不像欢迎我们的手臂？
欢迎姐姐！也欢迎我！
找到了！它真的一直坐在那里。
它怎么不理我？
再仔细看看。
啊！原来是一块像猴子的石头！
人们给它起了个名字，叫“猴子观海”。
海？可是，这里明明是山呀。
看它面前。
哇——白色的海！山尖像一座座小岛！
这些是云。云铺在山谷里，看起来像海，人们就叫它“云海”。
原来，这只石猴是在看云海。
还像……好多好多棉花糖。
四百多年前，有位旅行家叫徐霞客。他来过黄山两次，还把看到的景色写进游记。
他也会看到这些山和云吗？
山一直在这里，云却总在变化。今天我们看到的景色，也值得记下来。
一棵会欢迎朋友的松树，一只看海的石猴，还有一片飘在山里的白云。
你最想记住哪一个？
先都画下来。回家以后，我要讲给哥哥听！
